general.name: Docker Images monitor [Lin]
general.description: Alerts when a container on a moving tag is behind its registry tag by over N days; containers on pinned tags are reported, never alerted.

variables.name: minAgeDays
variables.description: An update does not count until the new image is this many days old. 0 disables.

variables.name: excludePattern
variables.description: ERE matched against container names; matches are skipped. e.g. ^(postgres|mysql)

variables.name: inspectTimeout
variables.description: Seconds per registry lookup. Safe range 10–60.

variables.name: cacheHours
variables.description: Reuse a previous registry lookup for this long. 168 = weekly.
